output.question: Who is Goldman Sachs' CTO?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, I couldn’t conclusively verify Goldman Sachs’ current firmwide CTO. Its latest relevant announcement names Dinesh Keswani as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering, a narrower role, on September 3, 2026. Goldman Sachs lists Marco Argenti as its chief information officer (CIO), not CTO.

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs announced Dinesh Keswani as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering, rather than explicitly naming him firmwide CTO.
Goldman Sachs identifies Marco Argenti as the firm’s chief information officer.

passages.quote: Dinesh will also serve as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering.
Marco is the firm’s chief information officer.

caveats: The verified appointment is specifically CTO of The Core Engineering; it does not establish who holds the firmwide CTO position.
Marco Argenti’s biography is undated; the date recorded above is the verification date.
